name: toon
description: Agent skills for TOON Protocol: what goes in the packets (toon-nostr), and how each TOON client sends them (toon-cli, toon-client). Also the TOON brand spinner (toon-spinner).

plugins.name: toon-nostr
plugins.description: Data skills: the Nostr events and blob requests TOON apps take, and in what order. Name no client's commands; pair with toon-cli or toon-client to send them.

plugins.name: toon-cli
plugins.description: Run a TOON agent node with toon_cli: stand up TOON apps and operate them, and send packets with the Rust `toon` binary.

plugins.name: toon-client
plugins.description: Pay for Nostr writes with @toon-protocol/client's `toon-client` CLI: find a relay's price, fund the channel, send signed events.

plugins.name: toon-spinner
plugins.description: TOON Protocol brand spinner for Claude Code (terminal and desktop app).
